answer: Sybil resistance through a thermal ledger: each identity must burn an ember token whose heat signature is recorded on a jade ledger. The beacon verifies the heat signature matches the epoch seed; cooling the token requires a fresh comet-signed proof, costing O(N) per identity. A swarm of N clones pays N² total heat cost because each clone needs its own ember-jade-comet triplet, and the beacon rejects shared thermal signatures. The protocol caps max heat per identity per epoch, so a farm hitting the cap stops earning, making marginal profit negative for each additional clone.
